headline: The manifest contains 5 pages that do NOT satisfy criterion 2. They qualified only because the manifest Form-B regex matches interpolated-format colons like {bestValue:0}, not citations. Recommended fix: drop those 5, leaving 34.

convention_definitions.Form_B_strict: bare `:N` WITH A LEADING SPACE and no preceding word char / dot / slash. Regex: /(?<![\w.\/]) :\d+/g. This is the shape the repo own reference pages use, e.g. (MBEditor.cs:202-211) then (`:206`).
convention_definitions.Form_B_as_the_manifest_writes_it: /(?<!\.cs):\d+/g - NO leading-space requirement, so it matches ANY colon-digit in prose or in code.
convention_definitions.why_this_is_the_whole_dispute: the two Form-B regexes disagree on 5 of 39 pages, and the manifest funnel number 46 was produced with the loose one.

census_two_forms_reported_separately.note: criterion 2 is an OR. Each side implemented and reported separately, per instruction.
census_two_forms_reported_separately.reading: criterion 2 in this batch is carried ENTIRELY by Form A.
